<!-- pr-reviewer: 943266847f28f750140aca181565b521d013a996 -->
**Verdict: no blockers found. The maintainer's real-control hold condition appears met. Maintainer: please lift the hold.**

I left `needs-rework` in place and added `needs-maintainer`. The `needs-rework` label is the maintainer's hold, not an agent finding, and this review does not lift it.

**What looks good**
- Every positioning move in the six Tormach probe goldens and in `probe_guard_moves.nc` is a protected `G38.3`, followed by its own `o50NN if [#5070 EQ 1]` / `(MSG, PROBE HIT ON POSITIONING)` / `M2` / `endif` block. The O-words are unique, and no plain `G1` positioning feed is left. The only unprotected non-touch moves are the `G0` rapids onto each new XY. Those were already in main, and the rapid is not a feed.
- Touches are `G38.2` with the search limit at the expected face, a `G91 G1` back-off away from the face, `G90` restored, then a slow re-touch at F1.18 (inch) / F30 (mm). Results are read from `#5061`-`#5063`.
- The tolerance check (`o901 if [ABS[#190] GT tol]` / `(MSG, ...)` / `M2`) comes before `G10 L20 P<n> Z[#5422-#190]`. A probe with no offset to set stops with `M0` and a message.
- Units are right: inch goldens use G20 with 0.0394 in back-offs and 0.0197 tolerance. The mm golden uses G21 with 1 mm back-offs and 0.025 tolerance.
- A 0-rpm touch probe writes no `S0 M3`, so `probe_guard_moves.nc` loses that line.
- The refresh matches what the PR comment says: every positioning `G1` became `G38.3` to the same coordinates, with its guard block.
- The diff touches only `tormach.cps`, goldens, tests and a decision file. It has no build.rs, `.github`, script or dependency changes. Cutting-op goldens are untouched.

**Local results** (merged with `upstream/main`, which was already up to date, so there was no conflict)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `probe_tormach` | 7 passed. The regenerated goldens are not stale. |
| `probe_op` | 12 passed, including `the_tormach_post_probes_the_op_with_g38_2` |
| `probe_guard` | 5 passed |
| `tormach_post`, `tormach_safe_retract`, `tormach_machines` | all green |
| `camcraft-post` | all green |
| `clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

**Real-control evidence, from the PR comments (the hold's conditions)**
- **Inch, run 1:** the contributor's Tormach 770MX (PathPilot 2.14.4) probed a top face. G54 Z moved from -8.3252 to -8.3259. A manual touch read 0.0009 against the cycle's 0.0007.
- **Inch, run 2** (#583 kit): two consecutive runs wrote G54 Z within 0.0003 in of each other (deviation -0.000276, then 0.000181).
- **mm:** the cycle completed. The error read -0.002438 mm, and an inch re-check right after agreed to under 0.003 mm.
- **Back-off:** the `G91` back-off retracted away from the face, and `G90` was restored.

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The hand edits to the earlier inch run (shortening the search limit, feeds in place of rapids) are tracked in #570, not here.
- The program leaves PathPilot in G21 after an mm run. This is noted in the PR thread and is a possible follow-up.
- The DEBUG value carries no unit. #583 will add one.
- The PR body still says "Draft until done" and "Not exercised". Please update the body to the recorded results before the merge.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
